talk.jaymospowers.pact.offer: You carry something bent. I can bend it once more. Slower, harder to kill, and everything you touch catches light. Fire will not hurt you. Water will. You keep it for life.
talk.jaymospowers.pact.sure: Once taken, it stays. No cure and no wish reaches it. Are you sure?
research.jaymospowers.skins.text: Earth, metal and crystal, bottled. Drunk, the draught waits a few seconds for something to touch. Touch stone, iron, glass, ice, wood, slime, honey, sponge, obsidian, sand, wool or a bell, and for a few minutes you wear its skin, with what it gives and what it costs.
research.jaymospowers.dampening.text: Mind and salt with a little shadow. The draught shuts a power away for a few minutes: its keys do nothing and what it does on its own goes still. It always wears off, and it takes nothing for good. Eight arrows set round a draught make dampening arrows (shorter on whoever they hit), and a draught with gunpowder makes a splash potion. Great foes shrug most of it off.
research.jaymospowers.release.text: Spirit, arcana and mind, drawn to a point on the altar. A person who drinks this twice, slowly, gives their power up for good. The power is left in a sealed phial for someone without one (a Xeno-Band is left as it is). Blood-born powers and a bonded symbiote will not part from their holder, and nor will anyone bound by a pact.
